name: Unit Testing

on:
  # Allows you to run this workflow manually from the Actions tab
  workflow_dispatch:
  # Full matrix on release branches
  push:
    branches:
      - 'release/**'
  # Lowest and highest supported versions on pull requests
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - develop

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  COMPOSER_VERSION: '2'
  ACTION_VERSION: 3

jobs:
  matrix_unit_testing:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: ${{ matrix.bleeding-edge }}

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        job-name: ['Unit Test']
        php-version: ${{ fromJSON(github.event_name == 'pull_request' && '["8.2", "8.5"]' || '["8.2", "8.3", "8.4", "8.5"]') }}
        wordpress-version: ${{ fromJSON(github.event_name == 'pull_request' && '["6.7.*", "7.1.*"]' || '["6.7.*", "6.8.*", "6.9.*", "7.0.*", "7.1.*"]') }}
        wp-multisite-mode: [0]
        bleeding-edge: [false]
        include:
          - job-name: 'Unit Test Bleeding Edge Requirements'
            bleeding-edge: true
            php-version: '8.4'
            wordpress-version: 'dev-master'
            wp-multisite-mode: 0
          - job-name: 'Unit Test Multisite Compatibility Requirements'
            bleeding-edge: false
            php-version: '8.4'
            wordpress-version: '7.1.*'
            wp-multisite-mode: 1

    name: '${{ matrix.job-name }} (PHP:${{ matrix.php-version }}/WP:${{ matrix.wordpress-version }})'

    services:
      mysql:
        image: mysql:8.0
        env:
          MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: password
          MYSQL_DATABASE: wordpress_test
        ports:
          - 3306:3306
        options: >-
          --health-cmd="mysqladmin ping -h 127.0.0.1 -ppassword"
          --health-interval=5s
          --health-timeout=5s
          --health-retries=20

    steps:
    - name: Checkout Code
      # https://github.com/marketplace/actions/checkout
      uses: actions/checkout@v7

    - name: Get Composer Cache Directory
      id: composer-cache
      if: ${{ !env.ACT }}
      run: echo "dir=$(composer config cache-files-dir)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

    - name: Cache Composer dependencies
      if: ${{ !env.ACT }}
      uses: actions/cache@v6
      env:
        composer-cache-name: cache-composer
      with:
        path: ${{ steps.composer-cache.outputs.dir }}
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-build-${{ env.composer-cache-name }}-php-${{ matrix.php-version }}-wp-${{ matrix.wordpress-version }}-v${{ env.ACTION_VERSION }}-${{ hashFiles('**/composer.lock') }}
        restore-keys: |
          ${{ runner.os }}-build-${{ env.composer-cache-name }}-php-${{ matrix.php-version }}-wp-${{ matrix.wordpress-version }}-v${{ env.ACTION_VERSION }}-

    - name: Setup PHP & Composer Environment
      # https://github.com/marketplace/actions/setup-php-action
      uses: shivammathur/setup-php@eb7c497e18156a6bbabfef1d3a82760b9eda3962 # 2.40.0
      with:
        php-version: "${{ matrix.php-version }}"
        tools: "composer:${{ env.COMPOSER_VERSION }}"

    - name: Environment Check
      run: php -v && composer --version

    - name: Require Specified WordPress Version
      run: composer require johnpbloch/wordpress-core:${{ matrix.wordpress-version }} wp-phpunit/wp-phpunit:${{ matrix.wordpress-version }} --dev --prefer-dist --update-with-all-dependencies

    - name: Install Composer Dependencies
      run: composer install --prefer-dist

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
